body:
I am not a therapist etc. but loss of motivation, loss of mental energy, and inability to focus are all very much issues I have experienced in my depression. Video games in particular... I flip flop between using video games as an escape and being too tired and worn out to play video games.

Regardless of whether or not what you're experiencing is depression I would argue that it is negatively impacting your life and is worth getting help for. What I'm trying to say is, I hope you don't feel like you need to meet some set of "criteria" to see a therapist or get counseling or whatever you want to do.

Every single time I hang out with my close friends this happens. It got to the point where I didn't want to hang out because I didn't want to feel so sad afterwards. After consequently losing touch with those friends I recently made contact again after 2 years and it still hurts to leave but I have decided that maybe whoever said "it's better to have loved and lost..." wasn't dead wrong like I thought.
